question: 按自然季度计算，2024 年第三季度（7–9 月）末 HP 的总资产是多少百万美元？

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT p.company_id, p.calendar_quarter, f.fiscal_year, f.fiscal_quarter, f.value
FROM facts f
JOIN periods p ON p.company_id=f.company_id AND p.fiscal_year=f.fiscal_year AND p.fiscal_quarter=f.fiscal_quarter
WHERE f.company_id='HP' AND p.calendar_quarter='2024Q3' AND f.account_code='total_assets' AND f.version='original'
ORDER BY f.fiscal_quarter DESC
LIMIT 10"}
